properties.description: `reflow2 update` keeps its word distinct from `init`: a project carrying an install receipt may be updated; a project that was never set up is REFUSED and told to run `reflow2 init`; a project holding a DESIGN but no kit is refused too and told WHY (machine-wide install, in-repo half never run) rather than silently receiving a first install; and the shipped wrapper both dispatches `--update` and states that it never downloads, so nobody expects a new binary from it (tools/test_init.py, 4 cases, 100 in the file). Pins the DISTINCTION, not the refresh — the refresh is `install` and every other case in the file covers it.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED THREE WAYS: accepting any directory kills two cases, dropping the design-without-kit branch kills exactly the one that names it, and dispatching `update` as a plain `init` kills the wrapper case. All refusals exit 1, verified by running them.
properties.name: reflow2 update keeps its word distinct from init
